It sounds like you're feeling burned out. That can be really overwhelming. Can you tell me more about what's been weighing on your mind and body lately? What are some of the specific stressors that are contributing to this feeling of running on empty?

Also, just to check in, are you taking care of your basics today - food, water, some fresh air?

It sounds like you're feeling overwhelmed and frustrated. That can be a really tough spot to be in. Take a deep breath with me... inhale deeply, hold it for a second, and exhale slowly. How do you feel right now?

It can be unsettling to experience physical symptoms like a racing heart, especially when you're about to tackle a challenging situation. Would you say that these feelings of anxiety are related to this meeting itself, or something more general that's been going on lately?

It sounds like tomorrow's review is really getting to you, and you're feeling a bit anxious. That restless feeling can be overwhelming, can't it?

Before we do anything else, take a deep breath in, hold it for a sec, and breathe out slow. Feel your feet connecting with the ground, and see if you can settle a bit.

When we're feeling anxious, it can be helpful to focus on the present moment. Try this: take another deep breath in, and as you breathe out, say to yourself, "I can handle what comes next." Just repeat that to yourself, and see how it feels.

Also, have you thought about a simple exercise to help calm your nerves? Would you like to try a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise? I can walk you through it.

It sounds like you're really struggling to get rest. Lack of sleep can make us all a bit sharper than we'd like to be. Have you thought about taking a few minutes today to do a body scan meditation? Just sitting quietly with your eyes closed, bringing your attention to different parts of your body, can help calm your mind and reduce stress. If you're short on time, even just one minute can make a difference.

It sounds like you've had a really challenging day. It's great that you can acknowledge how you're feeling. Would you like to take a moment to just acknowledge those feelings? What was one thing that specifically contributed to your rough day today?
